answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils via bottleneck trust routing on interaction graphs. Nodes across a peer nebula verify identities through credit paths from established seeds, creating an audited reputation haven. An attacker cannot scale fake identities without funding genuine exchange histories, incurring measurable capital and latency costs across each topological bridge to honest nodes. However, this marginalizes legitimate newcomers and fails if adversaries compromise the seed anchors.
